established.fact: Official test = 5,344 unlabelled JPEG word crops, 296-300 px tall, IDs 0-14806 (sparse); no labels, dev split, metric or format published.
Vision check: 13/13 viewed test images (7 ID buckets) are single handwritten Bengali words, blue pen. Only 13 of 5,344 viewed (0.24%); the full script mix is NOT measured.
Tesseract '35.7% Devanagari / 55.7% unknown' on 70 samples is a method artefact (tess hin forces Devanagari; install has only eng/hin/kan/mal/tam/tel, no Bengali). Retired; never quote as script mix.

Earlier heuristic profile of n=300 (seed 20260930): 273 handwritten (91.0%), 27 mixed, 0 printed; degradation clean 2 / mild 179 / severe 119 (99.3% degraded); script UNKNOWN for all 300. Heuristic-grade; precedes the 13/13 check.
Official hackathon text names full-page handwritten/cursive, mixed typed+handwritten and regional handwriting styles, so page-level handwriting is in the stated scope, beyond the word-crop test.
All 1,283 probe22 items are printed (0 handwritten, 0 tables; 983 quality unknown). Sarvam bench is 0% handwriting. No printed leaderboard/routing number transfers to the Bengali-handwriting test.

Only labelled handwriting on disk is Datasets/akshardrishti_official/Bodo/gu = Gujarati IIIT-HW: train 82,563 / val 17,643 / test 16,490 lines, vocab 10,963 (blind_verify says 10,964) - but only 4,645 images on disk (~5%); no Bengali labelled HW on disk.

H2 Gujarati manifest (official_hw_gu_test_manifest.json, 16,490 items) has no writer_id/page_id; disjointness is path-level only; manifest paths gu/test/N.jpg vs real gu/test/test/N.jpg; train/ and val/ absent on disk.
Bodo/gu/test/test/1.jpg is Gujarati (vocab[8831]); official test/test/1.jpg is Bengali: same filename, different set - a hash sweep must treat the mis-named folder explicitly.
IIIT-INDIC-HW-WORDS (Gongidi & Jawahar ICDAR 2021): 868K words (CVIT page: 872K), 135 writers; best in-domain CER 9.64% (10K pretrain) / 4.97% (82K pretrain); IAM pretrain gives 4.85%.
Bengali splits of IIIT-INDIC-HW-WORDS: train 82,554 / val 12,947 / test 17,575 (ilocr/PLATTER); the ICFHR-2022 page says test 18,574. Train count confirmed by ICDAR'23 Table 1; test count unresolved.
ICDAR 2023 IHTR (Mondal & Jawahar): 10 scripts; new manually annotated val 1,000 + test 5,000 words/lang from 100 writers; 18 teams registered, 6 submitted.

ICDAR'23 Bengali word results (CRR/WRR): Upstage KR 98.99/96.10 (PARSeq + SwinV2, synthetic then real pretrain, multilingual then per-language FT, ensemble); PERO 98.11/92.02; light (TrOCR) 97.54/91.62; SRUKR 96.01/88.06; CRNN baseline 93.46/75.34.

ICDAR'23 10-script winner averages: 95.94 CRR / 88.31 WRR (ledger). Other-script best WRR: Devanagari 93.16, Gurmukhi 95.28, Kannada 94.54, Malayalam 97.16, Odia 83.38, Tamil 98.08, Telugu ~91.4, Gujarati 62.80.
The ledger holds no per-language Bengali WRR; 96.10 is traceable only to the planner's read of the ICDAR'23 paper (not to ledger, consensus corpus or RESEARCH_DECISIONS).
Bodhan IndicOCR-HW (vendor bench, word acc): overall Gemini 72.0 / Bodhan 66.7 / Sarvam 55.4; Bengali 74.8 / 71.3 / 58.3; Gujarati 60.0/55.9/39.2; Telugu Sarvam 59.1 > Bodhan 53.5.

Bodhan handwriting covers EN + 12 Indic (hi bn ta te kn ml gu mr or pa as ur); none for sat/mni/ks/brx/doi/kok/mai/ne/sa/sd; vendor admits handwriting 'still being improved'; Bodhan loses 11 of 13 to Gemini on its own HW bench.
Bodhan numbers measured locally are printed only (300 gold pairs CER 0.4034 vs surya 0.5660; bench small_rep CER 0.054); no Bodhan handwriting-word run exists locally; PyTorch path needs CUDA.
Printed Bengali is weak locally: probe22 bn n=100 surya CER 0.476, IndicPhotoOCR 0.657, Tesseract 0.888 (printed, not handwriting) - Tesseract fallback for Bengali handwriting is not credible.

IndicPhotoOCR (Bhashini-IITJ, repo MIT) is a SCENE-TEXT toolkit: 11 Indic langs + EN PARSeq/ViT recognisers (bengali.ckpt etc. on disk); not handwriting-trained; no local accuracy figures, only non-emptiness on printed pages; weight licence unverified.
IndicPhotoOCR script-ID is a 12-class ViT (MIT, weights licence TODO) with no sat/mni classes; same-script language ID (Bengali/Assamese/Manipuri) is unsolved in OCR.

Fake-pass lesson: doctr-PARSeq with re-initialised Indic-vocab head scored script ratio 0.5337 but Jaccard-5 vs GT 0.0000 (glyph salad). Script-ratio gates are gameable; require CER/WRR plus a content floor (Jaccard-5 >=0.3).

PARSeq-style printed-to-handwritten transfer is strongest on most of 10 Indic HW benchmarks (Lalitha 2025); SemiHastakshar (IIIT-H, WACV 2026) adds unlabeled IIIT-INDIC-HW-WILD + HW-UC to close the writer-generalisation gap vs PARSeq HTR baseline.

PLATTER + CHIPS (arXiv 2502.06172, IIIT-H/IITB): page-level Indic handwriting (CC-BY-4.0 dataset per ledger), tested on Bengali among 7 scripts; ICDAR 2025 IHDR (13 scripts, winner 2025-05-15, no winner/score logged); UniLipi (13 scripts) - page-level assets plan v4 ignores.

Label cleaning alone gave up to 1.8 CER pts on Arabic-script HTR; cross-script transfer helps most at 100-1000 target lines and shrinks as data grows; no Bengali HW CER in corpus (best: Kannada 1.5% CER, Hindi 2.14% CER / 7.96% WER).
Cross-script/English: IAM English HW pretraining gives small positive transfer (4.85 vs 4.97 CER), supporting shared backbone with per-script heads.

Licence status: IIIT-INDIC-HW-WORDS = CC BY 4.0 per AIKosh/IndiaAI (planner); ICFHR-2022 page 'All Rights Reserved'; IHTR-2023/IHDR-2025 cards 'academic-use' (eval-only); ledger states no licence for the WORDS card itself. BN-HTRd licence unchecked.

Independent-writer eval candidates: BN-HTRd (Mendeley 743k6dm543; 108,181 Bangla words, 150 writers; licence TO CHECK) and ICDAR'23 test (100 new writers, academic-use, eval-only). Synthetic Pango/HarfBuzz+OFL fonts = pretraining only.

Plan v4 gates as written: HW0 hash test images vs IIIT bn train/val/test + ICDAR'23 before any training; HW1 zero-shot (IndicPhotoOCR bn, Bodhan HW, Tesseract ben) on IIIT bn val + 200 official test images (viewed only); G-2.5 before HW2; HW2 >=92% WRR IIIT bn val and >=85% independent writers.

Pre-registered kills: (a) test not IIIT-like if a stratified 100-image view shows <80% single handwritten words; (b) fine-tune <85% WRR on independent writers; <85% after 2 epoch-equivalents -> switch to CRNN+LM (PERO) or PARSeq-base.

PPT slide 2 already lists IIIT-HW / INDIC-HW-WORDS (10 scripts, ~872K words) as 'Handwriting branch pretrain/fine-tune'; Sarvam Vision 2.1 claims Indic handwriting (from videos) - continuity, and a named rival axis.

Zero handwriting in the 400-page benchmark (L1 ~2 handwritten-span labels) while the deck promises handwritten exam scripts: biggest data-pitch gap; earlier plan was IIIT-HW crops as parallel mini-bench.
PARSeq code is Apache-2.0 (baudm/parseq); IndicPhotoOCR recognition weights come from anikde/STocr releases V2.0.0 with licence unverified (only script-ID weights closed MIT).

Harness law for any HW claim: n<50 no winner; Wilson 95% CIs; McNemar exact / paired bootstrap; report median CER + abstain rate (empty = CER 1.0); public WRR numbers are not harness scores (transfer obituary).
